versions.changelog:
Initial release of agent-swarm-dev-team.

- Orchestrates multiple AI coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, and Gemini) to automate development tasks
- Each agent runs in an isolated Git worktree and tmux session for interference-free workflows
- Automated code review process using three different AI models
- Robust monitoring with periodic cron checks and automatic agent recovery
- Built-in prompt self-improvement system (Ralph Loop V2)
- Supports alternative notification and monitoring platforms for China-based users
